title: Ambiguous grid squares
statement: How many squares are there on a $4 \times 4$ grid?
hints: Sort the squares by side length.
A square of side $s$ has $5 - s$ positions in each direction.
solution: A square of side $s$ can be placed in $(5-s)^2$ ways, so the total is $16 + 9 + 4 + 1 = 30$. Why this works. casework: sorting the squares by side length splits the count into simple cases.
